fusion.fused_margin_rule: min(seam margin within the restricted set, autocorrelation separation margin) when autocorrelation carried; seam margin otherwise; zero when the streams contest
fusion.horizontal_stream: fractional-lag correlation of the column projection on the mixed-width probe's own 0.05px grid; corroborates or contests the probe, never overrides it
fusion.restriction_rule: a decisive autocorrelation leader restricts the seam ranking to its harmonic ladder, and refutes any harmonic rejection whose parent is off that ladder
fusion.separation_rule: relative prominence margin over the best non-ladder rival >= periodic_authority_margin
